en.t: Emperor Charles the Fat is deposed by the Frankish magnates in an assembly at Frankfurt, leading his nephew, Arnulf of Carinthia, to declare himself king of the East Frankish Kingdom in late November
en.s: Charles the Fat (839 – 13 January 888) was the emperor of the Carolingian Empire from 881 to 887. A member of the Carolingian dynasty, Charles was the youngest son of Louis the German and Hemma, and a great-grandson of Charlemagne. He was the last Carolingian emperor of legitimate birth and the last to rule a united kingdom of the Franks.

zh.t: 胖子查理在法兰克福会议上被法兰克贵族废黜，其侄子卡林西亚的阿努尔夫于11月下旬自立为东法兰克王国国王
zh.s: 胖子查理（839年—888年1月13日）于881年至887年担任加洛林帝国皇帝。他是加洛林王朝成员，日耳曼人路易与埃玛之子，也是查理曼的曾孙。他是最后一位具有合法出身的加洛林皇帝，也是最后一位统治统一法兰克王国的君主。

en.s: The naval battle of Mizushima took place on 17 November 1183. One of the most important bases of the Taira was Yashima, a small island off the coast of Shikoku. In November of 1183, Minamoto no Yoshinaka sent an army to cross the Inland Sea to Yashima, but they were caught by the Taira just offshore of Mizushima (水島), a small island of Bitchu Province, just off Honshū. The Taira tied their ships together, and placed planks across them to form a flat fighting surface.

zh.s: 水岛海战于1183年11月17日爆发。平氏的重要据点之一是屋岛，这是一座位于四国海岸外的小岛。1183年11月，源义仲派军队横渡濑户内海前往屋岛，但在水岛附近海域遭到平氏拦截。水岛是备中国附近的一座小岛，位于本州海岸外。平氏把船只连在一起，并在船上铺设木板，形成平坦的作战平台。

en.t: John Balliol becomes King of Scotland
en.s: John (de) Balliol (c. 1249 – late 1314), known derisively as Toom Tabard (meaning 'empty coat'), was King of Scots from 1292 to 1296. Little is known of his early life. After the death of Margaret, Maid of Norway, Scotland entered an interregnum during which several competitors for the Crown of Scotland put forward claims.

zh.t: 约翰·巴利奥尔成为苏格兰国王
zh.s: 约翰·德·巴利奥尔（约1249年—1314年末），被蔑称为“空斗篷”，于1292年至1296年担任苏格兰国王。他早年经历鲜为人知。挪威少女玛格丽特去世后，苏格兰进入王位空缺期，多名竞争者提出王位继承主张。

en.t: Sharif ul-Hāshim establishes the Sultanate of Sulu
en.s: The Sultanate of Sulu (Tausug: Kasultanan sin Sūg; Central Sama: Kasultanan Sūg or Kasultanan Sūk; Malay: Kesultanan Suluk; Filipino: Kasultanan ng Sulu or Sultanato ng Sulu) was a Sunni Muslim Tausūg state that ruled the Sulu Archipelago, coastal areas of Zamboanga City, and certain portions of Palawan in today's Philippines, alongside parts of present-day Sabah and North Kalimantan in north-eastern Borneo.

zh.t: 谢里夫·乌尔-哈希姆建立苏禄苏丹国
zh.s: 苏禄苏丹国（陶苏格语：Kasultanan sin Sūg；中萨马语：Kasultanan Sūg或Kasultanan Sūk；马来语：Kesultanan Suluk；菲律宾语：Kasultanan ng Sulu或Sultanato ng Sulu）是一个逊尼派穆斯林陶苏格人国家，曾统治今菲律宾的苏禄群岛、三宝颜市沿海地区及巴拉望部分地区，以及今婆罗洲东北部的沙巴和北加里曼丹部分地区。

en.s: The battle of Verkhovichi was a battle between Russians and Poles-Lithuanians, took place near village of Verkhovichi 17 November 1655 during Russo-Polish War. The battle is notable for the fact that the weaker and surrounded troops were able to completely defeat the army that surrounded them and capture the spoils.

zh.s: 1655年11月17日，俄军与波兰立陶宛联军在韦尔霍维奇村附近交战。被包围且兵力较弱的一方彻底击败了包围他们的军队，并缴获了战利品，这场战斗因此而闻名。

en.t: The city of Kuopio, Finland (belonging to Sweden at this time) is founded by King Gustav III of Sweden
en.s: Kuopio ( koo-OH-pee-oh, Finnish: [ˈkuo̯pio] ) is a city in Finland and the regional capital of North Savo. It is located in the Finnish Lakeland. The population of Kuopio is approximately 127,000, while the sub-region has a population of approximately 148,000. It is the 8th most populous municipality in Finland, and the seventh most populous urban area in the country.

zh.t: 芬兰库奥皮奥市由瑞典国王古斯塔夫三世建立
zh.s: 库奥皮奥（读音：koo-OH-pee-oh；芬兰语：ˈkuo̯pio）是芬兰城市，也是北萨沃尼亚区首府，位于芬兰湖区。库奥皮奥人口约127,000人，次区域人口约148,000人。它是芬兰人口第八多的市镇，也是全国人口第七多的城市地区。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Virginia on November 17, 1784. The delegate from Henry County Patrick Henry, who had served as the 1st governor of Virginia from 1776 to 1779, was elected to a fourth non-consecutive term. The incumbent governor Benjamin Harrison V was ineligible for re-election due to term limits established by the Constitution of Virginia. The election was conducted by the Virginia General Assembly in joint session.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州于1784年11月17日举行州长选举。亨利县代表帕特里克·亨利当选，开始第四个非连续任期。他曾于1776年至1779年担任弗吉尼亚州首任州长。时任州长本杰明·哈里森五世受弗吉尼亚州宪法规定的任期限制影响，不能竞选连任。选举由弗吉尼亚州议会联席会议举行。

en.s: The 1785 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 17, 1785, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Candidate William Smallwood was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against his opponent, former President of the Maryland Senate Daniel of St. Thomas Jenifer. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1785年马里兰州州长选举于1785年11月17日举行，选出该州州长。威廉·斯莫伍德在马里兰州议会投票中击败对手、前参议院议长丹尼尔·圣托马斯·詹尼弗，当选州长。此次选举的具体结果不详。

en.s: The 1790 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 17, 1790, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. Incumbent Federalist Governor Alexander Martin was re-elected by the North Carolina General Assembly against former Federalist member of the North Carolina Senate Charles Johnson.

zh.s: 1790年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于1790年11月17日举行，选出该州州长。时任联邦党州长亚历山大·马丁在北卡罗来纳州议会投票中击败前州参议员、联邦党人查尔斯·约翰逊，成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Biesingen took place during the War of the First Coalition on 17 November 1793 at Biesingen, now a district of Blieskastel. It occurred between a Prussian force under General Friedrich Adolf von Kalckreuth and a French one (mainly new conscripts) under General Louis-Lazare Hoche, ending in a Prussian victory.

zh.s: 比辛根战役于1793年11月17日在第一次反法同盟战争期间发生，战场位于比辛根（今属布利斯卡斯特尔）。普鲁士军队由弗里德里希·阿道夫·冯·卡尔克罗伊特将军指挥，法军（主要由新征召的士兵组成）由路易-拉扎尔·奥什将军指挥。最终普军获胜。

en.s: The 1794 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 17, 1794, in order to elect the Governor of Maryland. Federalist candidate and former member of the Maryland House of Delegates John Hoskins Stone was elected by the Maryland General Assembly against his opponent, fellow Federalist candidate Levin Winder. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1794年马里兰州州长选举于1794年11月17日举行，选出该州州长。联邦党候选人、马里兰州众议院前议员约翰·霍斯金斯·斯通在州议会投票中击败同为联邦党人的对手莱文·温德尔，当选州长。此次选举的具体结果不详。

en.s: The Battle of Arcole or Battle of Arcola (15–17 November 1796) was fought between French and Austrian forces 25 kilometres (16 mi) southeast of Verona during the War of the First Coalition, a part of the French Revolutionary Wars. The battle saw a bold maneuver by Napoleon Bonaparte's French Army of Italy to outflank the Austrian army led by József Alvinczi and cut off its line of retreat.

zh.s: 1796年11月17日，持续三天的阿尔科莱战役结束。拿破仑率领的法军在意大利维罗纳东南与奥地利军队交战，试图迂回敌军并切断其退路。这场战役属于法国大革命战争中的第一次反法同盟战争。

en.s: During the Napoleonic Wars until 1810, Sweden and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland were allies in the war against Napoleon. As a result of Sweden's defeat in the Finnish War and the Pomeranian War, and the following Treaty of Fredrikshamn and Treaty of Paris, Sweden declared war on the UK.

zh.s: 拿破仑战争期间，瑞典和大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国曾是反法同盟的盟友。瑞典在芬兰战争和波美拉尼亚战争中战败，随后签订《腓特烈港条约》和《巴黎条约》，并向英国宣战。

en.s: The siege of Naarden was an investment of the city of Naarden from November 1813 until May 1814 by a Dutch and Russian army as part of the liberation of the Netherlands during the War of the Sixth Coalition. This siege took months, since the French commander didn't believe that Napoleon had been defeated and had abdicated. Finally, the French soldiers were granted a retreat with honour.

zh.s: 1813年11月17日，荷兰和俄国军队开始围困荷兰纳尔登城。这场围城持续到1814年5月，是第六次反法同盟战争期间荷兰解放行动的一部分。法军守将迟迟不相信拿破仑已经战败退位，最终守军获准体面撤离。

en.t: 1836 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in North Carolina on November 17, 1836 as part of the 1836 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina voted for the Democratic candidate, Martin Van Buren, over Whig candidate Hugh Lawson White. Van Buren won North Carolina by a margin of 6.21%.

zh.t: 1836年美国总统选举：北卡罗来纳州
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州于1836年11月17日举行总统选举，是1836年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名代表，也就是选举人团成员，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。北卡罗来纳州支持民主党候选人马丁·范布伦，击败辉格党候选人休·劳森·怀特。范布伦以6.21%的优势赢得该州。

en.t: An earthquake in Valdivia, south-central Chile, causes a tsunami that leads to significant destruction along Japan's coast
en.s: The 1837 Valdivia earthquake struck south-central Chile on November 7. Together with earthquakes in 1575 and 1737 the earthquake is among the historical predecessors to the great 1960 earthquake. The rupture zone was roughly from Valdivia to the south. It was felt in the cities of Concepción, Valdivia and Ancud. The earthquake was also felt by the crew of whaling ships in Guafo Island and Chonos Archipelago.

zh.t: 瓦尔迪维亚地震引发海啸，导致日本沿海遭受严重破坏
zh.s: 1837年瓦尔迪维亚地震于11月7日袭击智利中南部。与1575年和1737年的地震一样，它是1960年大地震的历史前兆之一。震源破裂区大致从瓦尔迪维亚向南延伸。康塞普西翁、瓦尔迪维亚和安库德等城市均有震感，瓜福岛和奇洛埃群岛的捕鲸船船员也感受到了地震。

en.s: The Second Battle of Masaya (15 November 1856 – 17 November 1856) took place in the town of Masaya, northwest of William Walker’s filibuster capital, Granada. Having fought an inconclusive battle there the previous month, Walker again aimed to capture the valuable fortified town. The assault and subsequent siege of the town was inconclusive, as the heavy losses suffered on both sides still did not produce a definitive result, with Walker’s men withdrawing back to Granada after three days and nights of fighting.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次马萨亚战役于1856年11月15日至17日在马萨亚镇发生。马萨亚位于威廉·沃克冒险军政府首都格拉纳达西北方。沃克上个月曾在此与对手打成平手，此次又试图攻占这座重要的设防城镇。但攻城和围城仍未分出胜负，双方伤亡惨重，沃克的部队经过三天三夜战斗后撤回格拉纳达。

en.s: The Battle of Mustang Island (November 17, 1863) was fought in Texas during the American Civil War. It was part of a campaign by Major General Nathaniel P. Banks to occupy positions along the Texas coast. One of Banks's forces attacked a Confederate fort, capturing its small garrison.

zh.s: 马斯坦岛战役于1863年11月17日在美国内战期间的得克萨斯州发生。战役属于纳撒尼尔·P·班克斯少将夺取得州沿海据点的行动之一。班克斯的一支部队进攻一座邦联堡垒，并俘获了堡垒内人数不多的守军。

en.s: The siege of Knoxville (November 17 – December 4, 1863) saw Lieutenant General James Longstreet's Confederate forces besiege the Union garrison of Knoxville, Tennessee, led by Major General Ambrose Burnside, in the American Civil War. When Major General William T. Sherman approached Knoxville with an overwhelming Union force, Longstreet ended the siege on December 4 and withdrew northeast. The siege was part of the Knoxville campaign of the Civil War.

zh.s: 1863年11月17日，美国南北战争中的诺克斯维尔围城战开始。詹姆斯·朗斯特里特率领南军包围安布罗斯·伯恩赛德指挥的北军守城部队。12月4日，威廉·谢尔曼率援军逼近，南军解除围困并撤退。

en.s: The action of 17 November 1865 was a minor naval engagement that took place off Tomé, during the Chincha Islands War. Chilean tugboat Independencia captured a Spanish gunboat who belonged to the frigate Resolución.

zh.s: 1865年11月17日，钦查群岛战争期间，智利拖船“独立”号在托梅附近海域俘获了西班牙护卫舰“雷索卢西翁”号的一艘炮艇。这是一场规模较小的海战。

en.t: The Suez Canal opens to navigation
en.s: On November 17, 1869, the Suez Canal opened to navigation in Egypt, connecting the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea after a decade of construction.

zh.s: 1869年11月17日，历经十年修建的苏伊士运河在埃及正式通航，将地中海与红海连接起来。

en.s: The Battle of Dreux was fought during the Franco-Prussian War, which took place on 17 November 1870. In this brief and drastic battle, the Prussian army who was commanded by Grand Duke Friedrich Franz II beat the French army who was commanded by Captain Keratry who ordered across the frontline and forcing the French to hurriedly flee, despite the numerical advantage of the French.

zh.s: 1870年11月17日，普法战争中的德勒战役爆发。弗里德里希·弗朗茨二世率领的普鲁士军队击败法军，迫使对方仓促撤退，尽管法军人数占优。

en.s: The siege of Mézières was a siege battle during the Franco-Prussian War, it took place from November 17, 1870 until January 2, 1871, in Mézières-en-Gâtinais which is located on the banks right of the river Meuse in France. After suffering from a German artillery strike, the French army at Mézières under the command of Colonel Vernet, surrendered to Germany under the command of Major General Wilhelm von Woyna on January 2, 1871.

zh.s: 梅济耶尔围城战是普法战争期间的一场围城战，从1870年11月17日持续至1871年1月2日，发生在法国默兹河右岸的梅济耶尔昂加蒂奈。德军炮击后，韦尔内上校指挥的法军于1871年1月2日向威廉·冯·沃伊纳少将指挥的德军投降。

en.s: The Battle of Ladon and Mézières was fought at Ladon and Mézières-en-Gâtinais between the French Army of the Loire led by Louis d'Aurelle de Paladines and Imperial German Army led by Prince Friedrich Karl of Prussia on November 17, 1870. During the battle the Prussians forced the French forces to retreat into the Bellegarde woods.

zh.s: 拉东和梅济耶尔战役于1870年11月17日发生在拉东和梅济耶尔，交战双方是路易·多雷勒·德帕拉迪纳率领的卢瓦尔军团和普鲁士亲王腓特烈·卡尔率领的德意志帝国军队。战斗中，普军迫使法军撤入贝尔加德树林。

en.s: The Battle of Kars was a Russian victory over the Ottoman Empire during the Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878). The battle for the city took place on November 17, 1877, and resulted in the Russians capturing the city along with a large portion of the Ottoman forces defending the city. Although the actual battle for the city lasted a single night, fighting for the city began in the summer of that year.

zh.s: 卡尔斯战役是俄土战争（1877至1878年）期间俄国战胜奥斯曼帝国的一场战役。攻打卡尔斯城的战斗于1877年11月17日进行，俄军攻占该城，并俘获大量奥斯曼守军。虽然攻城战只持续了一夜，但双方从当年夏季起就已开始争夺该城。

en.s: The 1880 New South Wales colonial election was held between 17 November and 2 December 1880. This election was for all of the 108 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 43 single-member constituencies, 25 2-member constituencies, one 3-member constituency and three 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.s: 1880年新南威尔士殖民地议会选举于11月17日至12月2日举行，改选立法议会全部108个席位。选区包括43个单席选区、25个双席选区、1个三席选区和3个四席选区，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: Called the "Battle of the captains vs the generals" by historians,referring to the young Bulgarian army, whose highest rank went up to a captain, the Battle of Slivnitsa (Bulgarian: Битка при Сливница,Serbian: Битка на Сливници) was a decisive factor in the victory of the Bulgarian army over the Serbians on November 17–19, 1885 in the Serbo-Bulgarian War. It solidified the unification between the kingdom of Bulgaria and Eastern Rumelia.

zh.s: 斯利夫尼察战役被历史学家称为“上尉对将军之战”，指当时保加利亚军队的最高军衔只有上尉。1885年11月17日至19日，保加利亚军队在塞保战争中击败塞尔维亚军队，这场战役成为保加利亚获胜的关键。战役巩固了保加利亚王国与东鲁米利亚的统一。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 17 November 1895. They were boycotted by the Progressive Party and the Portuguese Republican Party, resulting in the Regeneration Party and a small number of independents winning all the seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1895年11月17日举行议会选举。进步党和葡萄牙共和党抵制选举，复兴党和少数独立候选人因此赢得全部席位。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 17 November 1902. Supporters of Theodoros Deligiannis emerged as the largest bloc in Parliament, with 110 of the 235 seats. Deligiannis became Prime Minister for the fourth time on 6 December.

en.s: The 1912 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship Final was the 25th All-Ireland Final and the culmination of the 1912 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship, an inter-county hurling tournament for the top teams in Ireland. The match was held at Jones' Road, Dublin, on 17 November 1912, between Kilkenny, represented by club side Tullaroan, and Cork, represented by club side Blackrock.

en.s: The 1912 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 13th edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by Argentine San Isidro and Uruguayan Nacional, In the match, played at Estadio Racing Club in Avellaneda, San Isidro won its first Tie Cup after beating Nacional (which played its first final in this competition) 1–0.

zh.s: 1912年Tie Cup决赛是这项由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同主办的国际赛事第13届比赛的决胜场。阿根廷圣伊西德罗队与乌拉圭民族队在阿韦亚内达的Racing Club球场交手。圣伊西德罗以1比0击败民族队，首次赢得Tie Cup；民族队此前也从未打进过决赛。

en.t: Second Battle of the Jiu Valley
en.s: The Second Battle of the Jiu Valley was a military engagement between German and Romanian forces during the Romanian Campaign of World War I. The White movement's stronghold on the Crimean Peninsula was protected by the Chongar fortification system along the strategic Isthmus of Perekop and the Syvash, from which the Crimean Corps under General Yakov Slashchov repelled several Red Army invasion attempts in early 1920.

en.s: Elections to the Legislative Council were held in Burma on 17 November 1925. Under the terms of the dyarchy constitution, the Legislative Council of Burma was advisory to the British colonial governor, and had some direct authority over education, local government, public health, agriculture and forests. The Nationalist Party received the most votes, but was unable to form a government as the British authorities favoured the Independent Party, who formed a government led by Joseph Maung Gyi.

zh.s: 缅甸于1925年11月17日举行立法委员会选举。根据双头政治宪法，缅甸立法委员会向英国殖民地总督提供咨询，并对教育、地方政府、公共卫生、农业和森林事务拥有部分直接管理权。民族主义党获得最多选票，但英国当局更支持独立党，后者得以组建政府，由约瑟夫·芒吉领导。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Australia on 17 November 1928. All 75 seats in the House of Representatives, and 19 of the 36 seats in the Senate were up for election. The incumbent Nationalist Party of Australia led by Prime Minister of Australia Stanley Bruce in power since 1922 with coalition partner the Country Party led by Earle Page defeated the opposition Australian Labor Party led by James Scullin. The election was held in conjunction with a referendum, which was carried.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1928年11月17日举行联邦大选，改选众议院全部75个席位和参议院36个席位中的19席。由总理斯坦利·布鲁斯领导的澳大利亚国民党与厄尔·佩奇领导的乡村党组成执政联盟，自1922年起执政；该联盟击败了詹姆斯·斯卡林领导的反对党澳大利亚工党。选举还与一项全民公投同时举行，该公投获得通过。

en.s: The 1928 Australian Senate election was held on 17 November 1928 to elect 19 of the 36 senators in the Australian Senate as part of the 1928 federal election. Each state elected three senators to serve a six-year term beginning on 1 July 1929, except for Queensland, who elected an extra senator to fill a casual vacancy. The Nationalist–Country Coalition won 12 of the 19 contested seats.

zh.s: 澳大利亚于1928年11月17日举行参议院选举，改选参议院36个席位中的19席，是1928年联邦大选的一部分。除昆士兰州额外选出一名参议员填补空缺外，各州均选出3名参议员，任期为6年，从1929年7月1日开始。国民党—乡村党联盟赢得改选的19席中的12席。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mexico on 17 November 1929. The winner of these elections was to serve the remainder of the 1928–1934 term for which Álvaro Obregón had been elected to the previous year before his assassination. The National Revolutionary Party, founded in 1928 by Mexico's most powerful leader at the time, Plutarco Elías Calles, made its debut in these elections.

en.t: The Tartu Art Museum is established in Tartu, Estonia
en.s: The Tartu Art Museum (Estonian: Tartu Kunstimuuseum) is a state-owned museum of art located in Tartu, Estonia. It was founded in 1940 on a private initiative by the members of local art school Pallas. This is the largest art museum in Southern Estonia. The main collection consists of works of art by Estonian and foreign artists, associated with Estonia, from the 18th century until now.

zh.t: 塔尔图艺术博物馆在爱沙尼亚塔尔图成立
zh.s: 塔尔图艺术博物馆（爱沙尼亚语：Tartu Kunstimuuseum）是爱沙尼亚塔尔图的一家国有艺术博物馆。它于1940年由当地帕拉斯艺术学校成员倡议创立，是爱沙尼亚南部最大的艺术博物馆。其主要馆藏为18世纪至今与爱沙尼亚有关的爱沙尼亚及外国艺术家作品。

en.s: The Ebbw Vale by-election of 17 November 1960 was a by-election for a single seat in the House of Commons of the United Kingdom. Caused by the death of Labour Party Deputy Leader Aneurin Bevan, the constituency was very safely held by the party and never in danger of changing hands. The selection of Michael Foot, a prominent leftwinger out of sympathy with the party leadership on nuclear disarmament and other issues, led to a lively campaign. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 17 November 1974. They were the first after the end of the Greek military junta of 1967–1974 and took place during the metapolitefsi era. The winner was Konstantinos Karamanlis and his newly formed conservative party, ND (New Democracy, Νέα Δημοκρατία). Karamanlis had already formed a government of national unity just after the fall of the dictatorship. The second biggest party was the centrist Center Union - New Forces (Ένωσις Κέντρου-Νέες Δυνάμεις). Third power in the Parliament became the newly formed PASOK (Panhellenic Sosialist Movement, Πανελλήνιο Σοσιαλιστικό Κίνημα), a radical socialist party led by Andreas Papandreou, son of the former prime minister Georgios Papandreou.

zh.s: 希腊于1974年11月17日举行议会选举。这是1967至1974年希腊军政府倒台后举行的首次选举，发生在希腊民主转型时期。康斯坦丁·卡拉曼利斯和他新成立的保守党新民主党获胜。独裁政权倒台后，卡拉曼利斯已组建民族团结政府。第二大党是中间派政党中间联盟—新力量。新成立的泛希腊社会主义运动（PASOK）成为议会第三大势力，该党是由前总理乔治·帕潘德里欧之子安德烈亚斯·帕潘德里欧领导的激进社会主义政党。

en.s: The North American Free Trade Agreement (Spanish: Tratado de Libre Comercio de América del Norte, TLCAN; French: Accord de libre-échange nord-américain, ALÉNA), referred to colloquially in the Anglosphere as NAFTA ( NAF-tə), was an agreement signed by Canada, Mexico, and the United States that created a trilateral trade bloc in North America.
